value.rationale: The theorem computes a natural exact invariant for an infinite noncommutative modular group-algebra family, including full homology dimensions of square-zero regular differentials. The characteristic-two quaternionic collapse is structurally nontrivial and distinguishes the eight-dimensional quaternionic block from the dihedral one; arbitrary odd parameters and finite fields follow uniformly. This has use independent of a paper-sized downstream theorem.
